name: hydrospectral-lab
install:
set -euo pipefail
# Cloud Agent checkouts live at /agent/repos/hydrospectral-lab. A local checkout is accepted only when its pyproject name is hydrospectral. HYDROSPECTRAL_REPO_ROOT overrides the agent path so the wrong-directory test can force this check. The unversioned curl-to-shell installer and the /usr/local/bin symlink are trusted Cloud Agent assumptions; the installer is not pinned.
repo="${HYDROSPECTRAL_REPO_ROOT:-/agent/repos/hydrospectral-lab}"
if [ -d "$repo" ]; then
  cd "$repo"
fi
if [ ! -f pyproject.toml ] || ! grep -q '^name = "hydrospectral"$' pyproject.toml; then
  echo "refusing install: not a hydrospectral checkout (cwd=$(pwd))" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
fi
if [ -x "${HOME}/.local/bin/uv" ]; then
  sudo ln -sf "${HOME}/.local/bin/uv" /usr/local/bin/uv
fi
uv sync --locked --group dev --python 3.12
